title: Word Frequency
prompt: Implement `word_freq(text)` returning a `std::map<std::string,int>` counting lowercase space-separated words, and `most_common(freq)` returning the alphabetically-first among the most frequent.

tests.name: counts
tests.code: auto f = word_freq(std::string{"b a b a c"}); CHECK_EQ(f.at(std::string{"a"}), 2); CHECK_EQ(f.at(std::string{"b"}), 2); CHECK_EQ(f.at(std::string{"c"}), 1);
tests.hint: Each word counted once per occurrence.

tests.name: most common
tests.hint: a and b tie at 2; map iterates sorted, so 'a' wins.
